app.name: Locturne: App Blocker
app.subtitle: Stop scrolling in bed. Get up.
app.promo: Your apps sleep at bedtime and stay asleep until you get out of bed. Walk, take the stairs, do push-ups or check in somewhere. Loc, a tired raccoon, won't negotiate.
app.description:
Locturne is an app blocker for your bedtime and your morning. The apps you pick go to sleep at bedtime, and they stay asleep until you actually get out of bed.

It's for people who scroll in bed at both ends of the night. Not when the alarm rings. When you're up.

Loc runs it. He's a raccoon. He's tired. Your phone keeps him up.

panorama.note: One background drawn across every panel side by side (x is in strip pixels: panel n starts at (n-1)*1320). Discs that sit on a seam carry over when you swipe. Deep tones only: out-of-focus shapes, not light.

panels.headline: Your apps sleep until *you're up.*
panels.note: The shield over a blocked app at night. Pick a category (Social) so no third-party icon shows. Real phone only. This is the panel people decide on: plain promise over real UI.

panels.headline: Walk *200 steps.* They wake up.
panels.note: Steps view near the end, around 180 of 200.

panels.headline: *You're up.* So are your apps.
panels.note: Morning payoff (/morning-won): Loc's yell, the moon up.

panels.headline: Bedtime at *11:30.* Not a request.
panels.note: Routine: bedtime 11:30 PM, morning time, wake-up method.

panels.headline: Or go *downstairs.* Same deal.
panels.note: Downstairs screen mid-trip, height meter partly filled. Still from a screen recording.

panels.headline: Or do *10 push-ups.* The camera counts.
panels.note: Push-up screen mid-set with the rep count showing.

panels.headline: Bad day? *Use a pass.*
panels.sub: Two a month. The only way out early.

panels.headline: Made by *one student,* not a company.
panels.note: Home in the day state, apps awake, Loc's line on top.
